install.title: Install the app
install.intro: Add the game to your phone's home screen: it opens full screen, like a real app.
install.a2: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
install.a3: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.a4: Confirm, then launch the game from the new icon.
install.i1: Open the game in Safari (not in another app).
install.i2: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
install.i3: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
install.i4: Tap "Add", then launch the game from the icon.
install.note: If you don't see the option, make sure you are using Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone), on the game's website.
